capabilities: Generate a Note Brief and per-section study cards with AI
Practice recall in a Study Mode with reveal-after-attempt
Keep study material current via managed folders and automatic updates
Export recall questions and key terms to Markdown or Anki TSV
Connect to cloud, local, or terminal LLM providers
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition flashcard plugin; it generates recall study material and can export to Anki rather than scheduling reviews itself.
extras: Community review flags Direct Filesystem Access and Shell Execution (needed for the optional Codex/Claude Code terminal providers). Free and open source under GPLv3. Requires Obsidian Desktop v1.11.4 or later for Secret Storage; cloud providers may incur usage charges and receive note content.
motivation: The author wanted retrieval practice from existing notes instead of passive rereading: "You highlighted it. You reread it. You still can't recall it."
problem: Re-reading notes makes them feel familiar without building actual recall, and Obsidian has no built-in active-recall or retrieval-practice feature.

relations.evidence: Export generated recall questions and key terms to a Markdown study sheet or Anki-compatible TSV
Use your own LLMs with Ollama or LM Studio.
Local servers: Ollama and LM Studio — generation can stay on your machine
The Codex and Claude Code terminal tools are also supported.

requires.name: Ollama, LM Studio, Codex, or Claude Code

summary: AI study-material generator that creates a Note Brief and per-section study cards (summary, recall question, key terms) from any note's headings.
